默认串行执行。每个压缩包使用独立目标目录，取消不删除已验证的完整结果。: Tasks run serially. Each archive gets a separate destination. Cancellation retains verified complete results.
解压输入必须为压缩包文件。: Extraction inputs must be archive files.
